957.overview: Blazingly fast futuristic motor cycle racing. Blast your opponents off the track with laser cannons, homing missiles and an assortment of other weapons, such as mines, bombs and tripwires - all at 300 MPH. Includes championship and multiplayer modes, with a tournament mode for 16 players, over a host of tracks set in four different worlds.

958.overview: In this second installment of Extreme-G, you once again will race with and against the incredible capabilities of G-bikes (they closely resemble of the ones in Tron) through several surreal, twisting tracks. Be hell on wheels blasting your challengers with an arsenal of vicious weapons and even break the sound barrier!

1094.overview: Earthworm Jim is hit by a flying cow that sends him into a coma. Jim awakens within his own mind and discovers he has gone insane. His past villains have entered his mind and if something doesn't happen soon, Jim will be in the coma forever. His super ego has been unleashed within his mind to stop the madness. To restore his sanity he must find the Golden Udders of lucidity. When Jim enters his mind, he finds out that his four mind chambers have been taken over by his worst fears. He must collect Golden Udders to unlock the other three chambers and Green Marbles to unlock the levels within the chamber. Jim defeats four villains who took over his mind chambers, and finally faces the personification of his trauma: Earthworm Kim.

1095.overview: Often imitated, never duplicated, ECW Hardcore Revolution takes you to Hell and back with the most intense hardcore wrestling action the human body can endure. Remember, scars never heal. Debut of over 40 hardcore ECW stars including Rob Van Dam, Sabu, Tommy Dreamer, Raven, Mike Awesome, Francine and New Jack! Real gutter-mouth crowd chants and commentary from ECW's Joey Styles. Brutal finishers and chair shots. "3-Way Dance" plus over 20 game modes!

1097.overview:
Excitebike 64 is an update to the original Excitebike, for the NES. The outrageous jumps and precision timing required in the original have been translated into a modern 3D racing game.

There are several game modes to choose from. First, there is a season mode with multiple skill levels. Completing a 5-race season in first place unlocks special tracks and more difficult classes. Second, there is a exhibition mode which allows you and up to 3 other people to choose a single track to race on. Third, there is a time trial mode in which you try to get the best times on the 20 tracks.

Finally, there are multiple special tracks. Some of the special tracks include a point-to-point race through the desert, a hill-climb competition, motocross soccer, and a pixel-perfect conversion of the original Excitebike. Excitebike 64 also includes a track editor for building your own competitions.

1135.overview: Join Disney's Mickey, Minnie, Donald and Goofy as they embark on a non-stop adventure full of challenging fun and excitement in Magical Tetris Challenge. Completely addictive, deceptively simple, you'll go wild in a kaleidoscopic shower of falling Tetris pieces in this magical version of the world's most popular video game.

1185.overview:
Celtland has been cast into chaos by the theft of Eletale's Book. This mystical volume contains the secrets of the Spirit Tamers. Control Brian, a magician's apprentice, as he explores the expansive countryside and villages on his quest. If he does not reclaim the book, the Kingdom of Celtland will be cast into darkness forever.

The Japanese Version, released a year later (July 9, 1999), contains several Gameplay (Such as the Defense and Agility stats increasing faster) and story differences (most importantly, a different ending). An overview of the changes can be found here (https://www.speedrun.com/quest64/guide/jivof) and here (https://tcrf.net/Quest_64#Regional_Differences).

25740.overview:
Eikou no Saint Andrews is an immersive golf game that takes players on a journey through one of the oldest and most iconic golf courses in the world. Released in 1996 for the Nintendo 64 console in Japan only, this game offers players the unique opportunity to play a round of golf on the legendary "Old Course" at St Andrews, Scotland, which was established back in 1552.

Players can choose to play as one of several well-known golfers, each with their unique strengths and weaknesses. As they progress through the game, they can unlock new characters, clubs, and equipment that can help them improve their game and achieve their goal of winning the championship.

The game features several modes, including stroke play, match play, and tournament play. In stroke play, players aim to complete each hole in as few strokes as possible. Match play involves competing against an opponent, with the goal of winning more holes than the opponent. In tournament play, players compete against a large group of opponents, with the goal of achieving the lowest overall score.

449796.overview: A rom hack for Super Mario 64 where you can make deliveries in this high speed arcade time attack hack made by Team Awesome Cool (SpK, Rovert, and FuryiousFight) for the 4th Mario Jams competition. Inspired by Crazy Taxi and Tony Hawk, master the many moves at your disposal to set a high score!

455152.overview: ECW House Party Mixtape is a WrestleMania 2000 hack, turning the game entirely into an ECW game. House Party was the name of a PPV that ran for 4 years annually from '96-'99. This hack consists of a huge ECW roster; over 7 pages to be exact, from Rhino, RVD, & The Dudleyz, to New Jack, Sabu, Sandman, & SO MUCH MORE! Want that ECW Title? Take yourself to the extreme on the road to get it, or create your own ECW Pay-Per-View! New menu screen, new movesets, new music, entrances, arenas, & titles based on that time period!

457357.overview:
ECW: Born to be Wired is a ROM hack of WWF No Mercy, based on RetroRandyPrice's NM V3 improvement mod. 

Features:
* New Roster
* New move animations
* New attire parts
* All new sounds
* All new music tracks
* Menu texture updates
* 5 count pin added to rules screen
* 10 count TKO
* In game free roam camera

458874.overview:
"My name is Elise."

ELISE is a Yume Nikki-like romhack in which you play as Elise, a fresh young adult who, in her despair, wished she could stay eternally asleep. This wish was granted to her and she is now wandering her own subconscious dreamworld. It is up to you to find all the dream drops, discover the story behind her predicament, and wake herself up from her slumber.

This hack was produced by Mel and ArcticJaguar725. It entirely refurbishes SM64, comes with an entirely original soundtrack, and also has voice acting to give you a unique Team Cornersoft experience like no other!

ELISE was made during and produced for the RHDC SM64 Dream Competition 2022.

462526.overview:
Evangelion Kart 64 is a Rom Hack (by Arian Ventura) based on Mario Kart 64 on the Nintendo 64. The game was released on August 30, 2025.

Evangelion Kart 64 features 8 custom characters with fully replaced custom voices:
Shinji, Asuka, Rei, Rei (Plush), Asuka (Plush), Shinji (Plush), Pen-Pen and Gendo.​ 
Other changes include custom title screens and menus; and Courses that have been re-textured to fit within the Neon Genesis Evangelion universe.

The game requires the 8Mb Memory Expansion to run.

462528.overview:
Evangelion Kart 64: Rebuild Edition is a ROM hack (by Arian Ventura) 
based on Mario Kart 64 for the Nintendo 64 and the "Rebuild of Evangelion" film series.

The game was released on October 3, 2025.

Evangelion Kart 64 includes five classic characters and three new custom characters with all-new voices: 
Shinji, Asuka, Rei, Kaworu, Mari, Misato, Pen-Pen, and Gendo.
Other changes include custom title screens and menus, and retextured tracks to fit into the universe of Neon Genesis Evangelion and Rebuild of Evangelion.

The game requires an 8MB memory expansion to run.

471145.overview: One day, Mario wakes up in a dark room... turns out he was captured and sent to an abandoned jail for years! Now he must find a way to escape and find out who is behind it! But will he be able to make it alive in this troublesome moment when the Mushroom Kingdom is under attack? Join Mario in this epic journey as he explores new worlds full of improvements and discover mysterious secrets that lies within the prison.

481958.overview:
Extreme-G: Turbo Fusion brings together the legendary high-speed combat racers Extreme G® and Extreme G®: XG2 in one adrenaline-fueled collection. This mashup delivers blistering futuristic racing across tracks built for pure speed. Manage your boost, carve through tight corners, and stay ahead while weapons turn every lap into a battle for position.

Missiles, mines, invisibility, and the infamous Willy Warp can instantly change the race. Precision and aggression decide who finishes first.

482881.overview:
Eltale Reborn: Holy Magic Century is a fan-made reimagining of Quest 64. Quest 64 was the first "real" RPG on the Nintendo 64, but a troubled development left it feeling unfinished. A few years later, a Game Boy Color version told the same story with a much fuller narrative. Eltale Reborn takes the GBC game's story and builds it into the N64 game, then expands on nearly every part of it.

Features:

- A rewritten story that follows the GBC version from start to finish, then adds a lot more.
- Towns full of new characters, each with its own little story and side quests.
- Lots of dialogue choices that affect your rewards and how people treat you later on.
- NPCs who remember you, and familiar faces who keep showing up throughout the journey.
- Polish and features from the Japanese release: critical hits, extra effects, menu animations, and map markers.
- A working economy, so you can buy and sell items in town.
- Reworked encounter rates and rewards, so there's no grinding.
- Rebalanced spells for both the player and enemies, so there's no "wrong" build.
- Atmospheric soundscapes for every scene.
